skill.summary: 根据关键词自动搜索潜在客户公司，提取联系方式（邮箱），输出结构化客户列表。 适用场景： - 用户需要寻找潜在客户时 - 用户需要获取公司联系方式时 - 用户提到"找客户"、"获客"、"销售线索"、"潜在客户"等关键词 - 用户需要查询已收集的客户数据 功能： 1. 根据关键词和地区搜索潜在客户公司 2. 访问公司...

latestVersion.changelog:
Lead Miner: Automatically search for potential customers and extract contact information.

Features
🔍 Multi-Search Engine Support: Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Baidu, Searx
📧 Smart Email Extraction: Website Crawling + WHOIS Query
✅ Email Verification: Format Validation + DNS Check
💾 Local Cache: Automatic caching to avoid repeated searches
🔄 Smart Deduplication: Skip already existing companies
🌐 Proxy Support: HTTP/HTTPS proxy support
📊 Data Statistics: View cumulative data
📤 Multi-format Export: JSON / CSV
